author: Arlene Palermo Hofler
text: Are the regular readings reading?  Is it just the highs and lows?  Try resetting them. Or I’m a big fan of turning it off then on again

author: Susie Ro
text: If the highs and lows have been fast changes the sensor can have trouble keeping up and sometimes gives the "check again in ten minutes" error. Is that what you're seeing when it won't read?
